text:
Pet arrivals this evening stayed on our minds, and we welcome your email regarding the delay in your companion animal's arrival and the distress it caused on an otherwise difficult journey.

I am replying as the shift coordinator for Aurelia Skyways, and I regret that our handling of this case fell short of the standard you were promised. The report before me shows that your concern centers on delayed departure handling, the welfare of your pet during the disruption, and the lack of timely guidance while you were waiting for an answer. That is not the experience the Companion Animal Travel Desk intends to create, and I am addressing it with urgency.

Our team does issue clear guidance before departure, and a welfare coordinator is assigned to review animal comfort needs so that we can act quickly if conditions change. Even so, a delay can unsettle travel plans and make a careful process feel disorganized from the passenger's side. We understand that the situation you describe left you feeling ignored and uncertain about whether your animal was being properly looked after. That concern is taken seriously.

Please note the following. <<FACT F115>>. <<FACT F109>>. If you wish to submit a claim, send all supporting details and any records from the journey without delay so that we can route the case for review at once. I also ask you to keep your message focused on the incident itself, because we need a clean file to move this forward swiftly.

We will also review the communication gap around your case and the handling steps taken by the team on duty. I am directing the desk to check the welfare notes, the transfer log, and the passenger updates that were issued, so we can correct any failure in process and prevent a repeat. If further action is required, you will receive a direct response from this office.

I recognise that apology alone will not repair the inconvenience, but it is due. We remain responsible for the care of companion animals entrusted to Aurelia Skyways, and we will act on this matter without further delay.

Companion Animal Travel Desk
